name: Living Room
tagline: The heart of your home where life unfolds
description: Handcrafted solid wood sofas, sculptural coffee tables, and elegant TV consoles designed for everyday living and memorable gatherings.

tips.title: Proportion Matters
tips.description: Leave at least 18 inches between your sofa and coffee table for comfortable legroom and easy movement.

tips.title: Layer Textures
tips.description: Combine solid Sheesham wood with textured cotton upholstery and warm ambient lighting.

tips.title: Focal Anchor
tips.description: Position your primary sofa facing the natural light source or central wall unit for balanced energy.

name: Bedroom
tagline: Calm, restorative sanctuaries for deep rest
description: Solid Sheesham and teak wood beds with ergonomic headboards, sleek bedside tables, and spacious modular wardrobes.

tips.title: Under-Bed Ventilation
tips.description: Ensure ample airflow beneath your bed frame to maintain mattress freshness in tropical Indian climates.

tips.title: Bedside Symmetry
tips.description: Keep nightstands at matching heights with the mattress top for effortless reach at night.

tips.title: Minimalist Visuals
tips.description: Opt for concealed storage to keep clutter out of sight, promoting calmer mental headspace.

name: Dining Room
tagline: Where meals become memories and conversations linger
description: Generously sized dining tables crafted from kiln-dried solid Sheesham, paired with ergonomic cushioned dining chairs.

tips.title: Clearance Space
tips.description: Maintain 36 inches between the table edge and walls to pull chairs out comfortably.

tips.title: Solid Wood Care
tips.description: Use trivets and coasters to protect the natural grain and lacquer finish from direct heat.

tips.title: Lighting Height
tips.description: Hang your dining pendant light 30 to 36 inches above the table surface for cozy illumination.

name: Study & Work
tagline: Focused workspaces designed for modern productivity
description: Ergonomic work desks with integrated cable channels, solid wood bookshelves, and supportive desk chairs.

tips.title: Ergonomic Height
tips.description: Ensure desktop height is between 29 to 30 inches to keep elbows at a comfortable 90-degree angle.

tips.title: Organized Surfaces
tips.description: Use dedicated wire trays and compact drawers to keep the primary working zone clear.

tips.title: Natural Light Orientation
tips.description: Position desk perpendicular to windows to avoid screen glare while enjoying daylight.

name: Storage Solutions
tagline: Smart, clutter-free storage with timeless silhouettes
description: Compact shoe cabinets, multi-tiered bookshelves, and multi-purpose credenzas built to optimize compact apartments.

tips.title: Vertical Optimization
tips.description: Utilize taller shelving units to maximize storage without consuming floor square footage.

tips.title: Entryway Organization
tips.description: Place shoe racks near entry points with a small landing bowl for keys and daily essentials.

tips.title: Multi-functionality
tips.description: Choose cabinets that can double as accent consoles for decorative styling.

name: Outdoor & Balcony
tagline: Turn cozy balconies into green morning retreats
description: Weather-treated teak and acacia wood balcony sets, bistro tables, and lounge chairs built for Indian weather.

tips.title: Weather Protection
tips.description: Cover or oil natural wood frames twice a year before and after the monsoon season.

tips.title: Space-saving Foldables
tips.description: Foldable bistro chairs allow flexible space utilization for plants and morning yoga.

tips.title: Outdoor Cushions
tips.description: Use quick-dry, UV-resistant fabrics that withstand sunlight and light moisture.
